hosea.4.p1.b1.text: Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel … There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!

hosea.4.p1.b2.text: Therefore the land mourns … even the fish of the sea disappear.

hosea.4.p1.b3.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you … Since you have forgotten the law of your God, I will also forget your children.

hosea.4.p1.b4.text: My people consult their wooden idols, and their divining rods inform them … They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar, and terebinth, because their shade is pleasant.

hosea.4.p1.b5.text: For Israel is as obstinate as a stubborn heifer. Can the LORD now shepherd them like lambs in an open meadow?

hosea.4.p1.b6.text: The whirlwind has wrapped them in its wings, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.
